body: On 2026-11-07 I filed an item and, in the same parallel batch, sent a message citing a made-up placeholder id ("w-ac1fde59a0a5 [check id below]") instead of the real one (w-af604716cb6b), and had to send a correction. Rule: never cite an item id in a message sent in the same batch as the add that creates it. File first, read the returned short_ref, then send the message in a later call.
